downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.57.21，选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.57.21. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 标签原地编辑：点交易的标签格直接输入，回车生成标签，Tab 跳到下一笔接着打。
highlights.en: Edit tags in place: click a trade's tag cell, type and press Enter, then Tab to the next trade.

highlights.zh: 标签管理：双击标签可以只改这一笔，也可以让所有交易和笔记一起改；还能统一合并或删除标签，改完可以撤销。
highlights.en: Rename a tag on one trade or on every trade and note at once, and merge or remove tags in Manage tags, with undo.

highlights.zh: 画线样式条增加删除按钮；价格测量卡片同时显示价差和点数。
highlights.en: A delete button on the drawing style bar; measure cards show the price move alongside points.

highlights.zh: 统计口径统一，胜率、收益率和回撤在各页面保持一致；图表周期在重启和打开存档后保持不变。
highlights.en: Consistent statistics: win rate, return and drawdown now match on every page; chart timeframes stay as you set them after a restart or opening a session.

highlights.zh: 保持绘图模式下文字也能连续写，点图表上的下一个位置接着写；多窗格同步画线时，任一窗格都能直接落笔。
highlights.en: Stay-in-drawing mode now keeps the text tool: click the next spot to write the next label. With drawing sync on, a picked tool works in every pane.
